title: Automatic Fine-grained Segmentation-assisted Report Generation
abstract: arXiv:2507.16623v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reliable end-to-end clinical report generation has been a longstanding goal of medical ML research. The end goal for this process is to alleviate radiologists' workloads and provide second opinions to clinicians or patients. Thus, a necessary prerequisite for report generation models is a strong general performance and some type of innate grounding capability, to convince clinicians or patients of the veracity of the generated reports. In this paper, we present ASaRG (\textbf{A}utomatic \textbf{S}egmentation-\textbf{a}ssisted \textbf{R}eport \textbf{G}eneration), an extension of the popular LLaVA architecture that aims to tackle both of these problems. ASaRG proposes to fuse intermediate features and fine-grained segmentation maps created by specialist radiological models into LLaVA's multi-modal projection layer via simple concatenation. With a small number of added parameters, our approach achieves a +0.89\% performance gain

translated_title: 自动化细粒度分割辅助报告生成
translated_abstract: 可靠的端到端临床报告生成一直是医学机器学习研究的一个长期目标。这一过程的最终目标是减轻放射科医生的工作负担，并为临床医生或患者提供第二诊疗意见。因此，报告生成模型的必要前提是具备强大的综合性能以及某种内在的可定位溯源能力，以使临床医生或患者确信所生成报告的真实性。在本文中，我们提出了ASaRG（自动分割辅助报告生成），这是对流行的LLaVA架构的一种扩展，旨在同时解决上述两个问题。ASaRG提出通过简单的拼接方式，将由专业放射学模型生成的中间特征和细粒度分割图融合到LLaVA的多模态投影层中。在仅增加少量参数的情况下，我们的方法实现了+0.89%的性能提升。
tldr: 该论文提出ASaRG方法，通过将专业放射学模型生成的中间特征和细粒度分割图以简单拼接的方式融合进LLaVA的多模态投影层，在仅增加少量参数的情况下提升了医学报告生成的性能与可信度。
en_tdlr: ASaRG extends the LLaVA architecture by fusing intermediate features and fine-grained segmentation maps from specialist radiological models into its multi-modal projection layer via simple concatenation, achieving performance gains in medical report generation with minimal added parameters.
